insight.headline: Order Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and applies to orders updated after August 31, 2026. The tax recalculation is based on the new shipping destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their order update logic to ensure it accounts for the tax recalculation. This change may impact order pricing and totals, so thorough testing is recommended. The orderUpdate mutation now returns an updated order object with the recalculated taxes. Developers can use the GraphQL Admin API to test and verify the new behavior.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations for orders with updated shipping addresses, reducing potential errors and discrepancies. This change improves the overall ordering experience and ensures compliance with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to avoid revenue loss and ensure compliance with tax laws. This change enhances the reliability and trustworthiness of the Shopify platform.

recap.headline: Shopify updates Hydrogen, GraphQL Admin API, and POS UI extensions

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.3 patch changes improve local debugger connections. Additionally, @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.1 patch changes improve the reliability of local debugger connections.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API and Shopify Functions
themes.detail: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field, and updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes.

themes.title: POS and Checkout Updates
themes.detail: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API, and merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests. The shopify-account component is also now a Theme Store requirement.

actions.text: Review and implement updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps

Ensure compliance with the new Theme Store requirement for the shopify-account component
Be aware of the August 31, 2026 update to tax recalculation for order shipping address changes
